purpose: Tintable frontal garment albedo maps; shallow normal/roughness details derived at runtime, not a high-poly bake.

prompts.vest: Photorealistic material scan, game asset albedo texture, single square 1024x1024 or larger. A perfectly rectangular seamless-looking FLATTENED FRONT SURFACE of a military armored plate carrier made of faded grey/neutral desaturated camouflage Cordura. This is a flat texture sheet to wrap onto a simple 3D chest mesh, NOT a photograph of an entire vest, NO silhouette, NO shoulders, NO armholes, NO model, NO mannequin, NO perspective, NO background, NO labels. The textile fills the image edge to edge. Central 80 percent area contains from top to bottom: a small horizontal blank velcro name patch near 12% height, three rows of accurately sewn horizontal MOLLE webbing between 25-48% height, FOUR vertical filled soft magazine pouches arranged side by side between 51-91% height with rounded fabric folds, overlapping flap closures, woven pull tabs and small dull black buckles. All details centered and bilaterally balanced. Reserve outermost 10% left and right margins as plain camouflage cloth with NO pouches. Dense realistic nylon weave, fine stitches, padded cloth tension, subtle dust, worn edges, convincing soft depth on pouches from VERY shallow neutral ambient occlusion. Grey camouflage in low contrast warm grey tones; almost monochrome so it can be tinted olive in engine. Absolutely flat straight-on orthographic view, uniform diffuse cross-polarized illumination, NO dramatic shadows, NO lighting gradient, NO glossy spots, no text, no logos, no watermark. Entire image must be usable as a texture with no border. The style is real photographed military fabric, NOT illustration or a cartoon.
prompts.tshirt: Photorealistic material scan, game asset albedo texture, single square 1024x1024 or larger. Perfectly rectangular flattened FRONT TEXTILE SURFACE for a mechanic work jacket in neutral medium grey cotton twill. Not an image of an entire garment: no shoulders, neckline, sleeves, armholes, person, mannequin or background; cloth fills every pixel edge to edge. Front zipper follows the exact center vertical line from top to bottom. Two symmetric square flat breast patch pockets occupy x 20-43% and 57-80%, y 22-46%, each with a small flap and double stitching. A narrow blank rectangular work badge at upper left. The lower half has realistic restrained cloth drape, wide soft folds, an industrial seam near the bottom edge and mildly rubbed cotton; no extra cargo pouches. Outermost left and right 10% remain plain cloth for sides. Fine real woven cotton fibers, small stitch holes, stitched pocket seams, smooth supple fabric, slight dirt around zipper and cuffs, generally well maintained. Neutral monochromatic greys for tinting teal in the 3D engine. Orthographic flat-on scan, uniform diffuse cross-polarized lighting, only subtle localized ambient occlusion in seams and folds, no strong directional shadows, no labels or text, no logos or watermark, no border. Real cloth texture, not illustrated, not a stylized render.
prompts.medic: Photorealistic material scan for a game, square 1024x1024 or larger: a flat rectangular albedo texture for the entire front surface of a compact repair robot's armored cuirass. NOT a whole robot, no silhouette, no neck hole, no limbs, no background, no perspective. Light neutral grey painted metal / ceramic panel material fills the entire image edge to edge. A narrow central vertical service seam runs from top to bottom. Symmetric pairs of very shallow inset service cartridges around x 25% and 75%, y 35-57%, with a few dark vents and fine narrow gasket channels. Two small muted turquoise status slits inside the cartridges, subtle. Lower half has two large restrained maintenance access panel outlines from y 65-90%, tiny screws, fine scratched paint around edges, tiny stencil-like calibration ticks but NO readable text, no logos. Top 15% and outer left/right 10% are mostly plain material. Keep broad uninterrupted painted surfaces, do not fill with greebles. Convincing very fine roughness, micro scratches, rubbed corners, extremely sparse small muted brown oxidation only at seams. Uniform flat cross-polarized diffuse lighting for PBR use, no baked strong shadows, no metallic reflections, no spotlight gradient, front orthographic view, no border, no watermark. Almost monochrome for tinting in the engine, with dark technical details and only those few turquoise marks.
